segments.title: Staff Report on Priority 2 Snow Clearing
description: City crews cannot consistently meet current P2 snow clearing timelines.
Only 75% of P2 streets cleared within 36 hours over four winters.
Option 1: Increase P2 timeline to 48 hours, no extra funding.
Option 2: Increase resources, $890,000 annually, plus $2M for graders.

chips.text: Option 2 requires $890,000 annually and $2,000,000 for graders.
Residents experiencing inconsistent P2 snow clearing are affected.
